I will apply inorganic fertilizer on this wheat plot because the cooperative provides DAP and urea, and I have seen that it helps the wheat grow stronger and give a better harvest. I will also spread manure that I have saved from my animals, since it makes the soil good. For seed, I will use my own local wheat seed that I kept from last season, not the improved kind. My family and I will do all the work ourselves since the plot is small, and I will not irrigate because we depend on the rains.
